source.notes: This inventory is a generated parity baseline for PIS prior-FCS coverage. Each row targets pis-fcs-legacy-benchmark suite implementation. Conditional rows require test-value/capability prerequisites.

records.description: Create domestic payment consent at /domestic-payment-consents and assert 201, FAPI header, AwaitingAuthorisation status, and ConsentId.
records.detail: Legacy script  O B-400- D O P-100100 targets  Domestic Payment at /domestic-payment-consents.  It is marked mandatory and uses instructed Amount Currency, instructed Amount Value, instruction Identification, end To End Identification, post Data, request Consent profile keys.  Assertions:  O B3 G L O Assert On201,  O B3 G L O F A P I Header,  O B3 D O P Assert Awaiting Authorisation V4,  O B3 G L O A Assert Consent Id.  Coverage is broad.
records.notes: Response x-jws-signature validation mapped to response_signature assertion.

records.description: Negative case: /domestic-payment-consents POST with signature error mutation, expect 400 with one-of OB signature error code.
records.detail: Legacy script  O B-400- D O P-100110 targets  Domestic Payment at /domestic-payment-consents.  It is marked mandatory and uses instructed Amount Currency, instructed Amount Value, instruction Identification, end To End Identification, post Data, request Consent profile keys.  Assertions:  O B3 G L O Assert On400.  One-of assertions:  O B3 G L O Assert Signature Invalid Claim Error Code V4,  O B3 G L O Assert Signature Missing Claim Error Code V4,  O B3 G L O Assert Signature Malformed Error Code V4.  Coverage is minimal.
